What does the `git stash` command do?

Arr, `git stash` be like buryin' yer treasure fer later! It takes all yer uncommitted changes and tucks 'em away in a hidden chest, leavin' yer workin' deck clean as a whistle. When ye be ready, `git stash pop` digs 'em right back up. Handy when ye must switch branches in a hurry, matey!

How do I reverse a string in Python?

Easy as swiggin' grog, matey! Ye slice her backwards: `reversed_str = my_string[::-1]`. That `[::-1]` be tellin' Python to sail through the string stern-first, one step at a time. No loops nor cannons required!

What is a hash map?

A hash map be a magical treasure chest, arr! Ye give it a key — say the name of an island — and it hands ye back the loot stored under that key in the blink of an eye. Under the deck it uses a hash function to reckon exactly where each treasure be buried, so lookups be lightning quick. In Python she goes by the name `dict`.

Why is my for loop off by one?

Ahoy, the dreaded off-by-one sea monster! Nine times outta ten ye be forgettin' that `range(n)` counts from 0 up to n-1, not 1 to n. Check yer `<` versus `<=` on the boundaries, and mind whether ye start countin' at 0 or 1. Plug the leak there and the beast be slain!

What's the difference between a list and a tuple in Python?

Arr, a fine question! A list be like yer ship's cargo hold — ye can add, remove, and rearrange the barrels whenever ye please, for she be mutable. A tuple be like words carved into the ship's hull — fixed and unchangeable once set. Use a list when yer crew be shiftin', and a tuple when the manifest must stay put, matey!

How do I make an HTTP GET request in Python?

Hoist the `requests` library and set sail! `import requests`, then `resp = requests.get('https://api.example.com/loot')`. Ye can read the treasure with `resp.json()` and check `resp.status_code` to be sure no storm sank yer request. Install her first with `pip install requests`, arr!

What is recursion?

Recursion be a function that calls its own self, like a hall o' mirrors on the captain's quarters! Ye break a big problem into a wee smaller one, then call yerself again on the smaller bit, till ye hit the base case — the shore where ye stop rowin'. Forget the base case and ye row forever into a stack overflow, so mind yer anchor, matey!

How can I read a file line by line?

Open the logbook and read her line by line, arr! `with open('log.txt') as f:` then `for line in f:` — Python hands ye one line each turn of the wheel without haulin' the whole file aboard at once. The `with` be makin' sure the hatch closes proper when ye be done. Smooth sailin'!

What does REST stand for?

REST be short fer Representational State Transfer, a mighty fine way to chart yer API waters! It means ye treat things as resources, address 'em by URL, and use the ship's standard signals — GET to fetch, POST to create, PUT to update, DELETE to send to Davy Jones' locker. Keep her stateless and yer API sails smooth, matey!

What is a merge conflict in git?

Arr, a merge conflict be when two pirates edit the same line o' the map and git cannae reckon which be the true course! It marks the clashin' bits with `<<<<<<<`, `=======`, and `>>>>>>>`. Ye must parley with yerself, pick the right riggin', delete them markers, then `git add` and commit the peace treaty. No bloodshed required, savvy?

How do I catch an exception in Python?

Batten down the hatches with `try` and `except`, arr! Ye wrap the risky code in `try:`, then `except ValueError as e:` to catch a particular storm and handle her gracefully. Add a `finally:` block fer chores that must run come high water or low. That way one rogue wave won't sink yer whole ship, matey!

What's the point of unit tests?

Unit tests be yer lookout in the crow's nest, matey! They be wee checks that prove each piece o' yer code does what it oughta. When ye change the riggin' later, the tests holler if ye broke somethin', so ye sail with confidence 'stead o' prayin' to the code gods. A ship without tests be one squall from the depths, arr!

Explain what an API is.

An API — Application Programming Interface — be the ship's wheel and levers that let one program command another without knowin' how the engine room works, arr! Ye send a request in the agreed manner and get yer response back, no need to swab the decks yerself. Think of it as orderin' grog at the tavern: ye ask, they serve, ye needn't brew it, matey!

How do I center a div in CSS?

Ahoy, the age-old quest to center a div — many a sailor has been lost to it! The modern route: make the parent `display: flex;` then `justify-content: center;` to center her port-to-starboard and `align-items: center;` to center her bow-to-stern. Give the parent some height and yer div sits pretty in the middle o' the deck, arr!
